about_the_game:
The Last Cure is a realistic bodycam-style co-op survival horror game that will test your teamwork and nerves. Trapped deep within a dark, decaying hospital, you and your friends must search for the last remaining cure before it’s too late.

But you’re not alone. Something hunts you—an unpredictable, relentless AI-driven enemy that reacts to your every move. Noise will betray you. Light might save you... or lead to your doom.

With intense proximity voice chat, communication becomes both your greatest weapon and your biggest risk. Will you whisper for help… or scream in terror?

Prepare for a short but heart-pounding experience inside an atmospheric environment filled with fear, tension, and a fight for survival.

✅ Features

Co-Op Survival Horror – Play with up to 4 players and face the nightmare together.

Realistic Bodycam Graphics – Immersive, gritty visuals that make you feel truly there.

Unpredictable AI – The enemy learns, adapts, and hunts you in unexpected ways.

Collect the Cure – Search for the last hope for humanity before time runs out.

Character Customization – Choose from 4 unique character skins.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti, 4GB or AMD Radeon RX 470, 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Survive the hunt in The Last Cure – a terrifying co-op survival horror where every sound matters, every shadow hides danger, and the cure is your only hope.
supported_languages:
English*, Russian*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
